description: Remove session-set profile and/or region overrides so subsequent calls fall back to env vars / defaults. No args clears both. Pass `profile: true` or `region: true` to clear just one. Use when the user says 'go back to the default profile,' 'unset the region,' or 'reset session.'

profile.description: If true, clear the session profile override. Default false.

region.description: If true, clear the session region override. Default false.

name: aws_session_clear
